title.narrative: Association of Legal Aid Against Sexual Violence

description.narrative: The project is implemented in Turkey. The main outcome areas it contributes to are gender equality and democracy and human righst. The main right holders are those who suffer from human rights violations in Turkey, mostly women and LGBTQ-people, actors in the civil society organisations and the government bodies.Through seminars, trainings, organising and mobilising, advocacy and capacity building the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between Women's Free Legal Aid Association, the Marieborgs Folk High School and The Palme Center. The local partner organisation works to contribute to the development of human rights and democratization, through its' operations to combat the violance against women and improve the life conditions of women, refugee women and trans-women in Turkey. The Marieborgs Folk High School, one of the Palme Center's member organisations, is highly engaged in the development in Turkey, with a memberbase intrested in contribution to the democratic development. They support this partnership with their specific focus on and expertise in adult trainings. The Palme Center will support the project through coordination, administrative support and technical support, such as capacity building and networking.Other Donors to the OrganisationThere are no other donors in the project.Project ObjectiveThe project's objective is to stop sexual violence by creating awareness of sexual violence and by struggling for the punishment of the perpetrators.Actor groupsThe main actor group in the project are those who suffer from human rights violations, especially women and LGBTQ-people. The organisations main actors within the group of,1) right holders are: women, lgbtq-people, minorities and the human rights activists in the civil society organisations.2) actors working in cooperation: the civil society organisations in Turkey and international organisations working on human rights and peace building.3) decision makers: the government agencies and the political leadership in the political parties, the international community with leverage on Turkey such as EU, UN and the Council of Europe.
